name: Auto.aux_CuboidNorm.endpointJump_cube_dom_of_overlap_formula
statement:
theorem endpointJump_cube_dom_of_overlap_formula {n J : ℕ}
    {ε δ : ℝ} (hεδ : ε ≤ δ)
    (N : Fin (J + 1) → ℕ) (T : ℕ → RVector n → ℝ)
    (D : ℕ → ZVector n → ℝ) (W : RVector n → ℝ)
    (hW : ∀ u, (∀ i, 0 ≤ u i ∧ u i ≤ ε) → δ - ε ≤ W u)
    (hT : ∀ (M : ℕ) (k : ZVector n) (u : RVector n),
      (∀ i, 0 ≤ u i ∧ u i < ε) →
      0 < M →
      T M (fun i ↦ (k i : ℝ) + u i) = W u * D M k)
    (hNpos : ∀ q, 0 < N q)
    (j : Fin J) (k : ZVector n) (x : RVector n)
    (hx : x ∈ latticeCuboid ε k) :
    ‖(δ - ε) * (D (N j.succ) k - D (N j.castSucc) k)‖ₑ ≤
      ‖(T (N j.succ) x - T (N j.castSucc) x)‖ₑ

name: Auto.aux_CuboidNorm.finite_jump_energy_lower_of_cube_dom
statement:
theorem finite_jump_energy_lower_of_cube_dom {n J : ℕ}
    {ε c : ℝ} (hε : ε ≤ 1) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (A : Finset (ZVector n)) (d : Fin J → ZVector n → ℝ)
    (G : Fin J → RVector n → ℝ)
    (hsupport : ∀ j k, k ∉ A → c * d j k = 0)
    (hdom : ∀ j k, k ∈ A → ∀ x, x ∈ latticeCuboid ε k →
      ‖c * d j k‖ₑ ≤ ‖G j x‖ₑ) :
    (ENNReal.ofReal c ^ (2 : ℝ) * ENNReal.ofReal ε ^ n) *
        ∑ j : Fin J, ∑ k ∈ A, ‖d j k‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ j : Fin J, eLpNorm (G j) (2 : ℝ≥0∞) volume ^ (2 : ℕ)

name: Auto.aux_CuboidNorm.finite_jump_energy_lower_on_of_overlap_formula
statement:
theorem finite_jump_energy_lower_on_of_overlap_formula {n J : ℕ}
    (hn : 0 < n) {ε δ : ℝ} (hε : ε < 1) (hεδ : ε ≤ δ)
    (hwidth : ε + δ < 1) (N : Fin (J + 1) → ℕ)
    (hNpos : ∀ q, 0 < N q) (a : Fin n → ZVector n → ℝ)
    (A : Finset (ZVector n)) :
    (ENNReal.ofReal (δ - ε) ^ (2 : ℝ) * ENNReal.ofReal ε ^ n) *
        ∑ j : Fin J, ∑ k ∈ A,
          ‖aux_integerDiscreteAverage (N j.succ) a k -
            aux_integerDiscreteAverage (N j.castSucc) a k‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ) ≤
      ∑ j : Fin J, eLpNorm
        (fun x ↦ ctTwistedAverageAtScale (N j.succ : ℝ) ctUnitIntervalKernel
            (fun i ↦ aux_liftRaw (aux_cuboidEmbed ε δ i (a i)))
            (WithLp.toLp 2 x) -
          ctTwistedAverageAtScale (N j.castSucc : ℝ) ctUnitIntervalKernel
            (fun i ↦ aux_liftRaw (aux_cuboidEmbed ε δ i (a i)))
            (WithLp.toLp 2 x)) 2 volume ^ 2

name: Auto.aux_CuboidNorm.mem_latticeAxisCuboid_iff
statement:
theorem mem_latticeAxisCuboid_iff {n : ℕ} {ε δ : ℝ}
    (hε0 : 0 ≤ ε) (hε : ε < 1) (hεδ : ε + δ < 1)
    (i : Fin n) (k : ZVector n) (y : RVector n) :
    y ∈ latticeAxisCuboid ε δ i k ↔
      (∀ j,
        if j = i then
          ε ≤ y j - (⌊y j⌋ : ℝ) ∧ y j - (⌊y j⌋ : ℝ) < ε + δ
        else

        (fun j ↦ ⌊y j⌋) = k

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.eLpNorm_count_sq_eq_finset_sum_rpow
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_count_sq_eq_finset_sum_rpow

    (hF : ∀ k, k ∉ B → F k = 0) :

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.finite_box_bound_of_finite_sum_cancelled
statement:
theorem finite_box_bound_of_finite_sum_cancelled
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} {n J M : ℕ}
    (hM : 0 < M)
    (T : (Fin n → ℕ) → X → X)
    (hT : ∀ k ∈ box n (M + M),
      MeasurePreserving (T k) μ μ)
    (p : Fin n → ℝ≥0∞) (N : Fin (J + 1) → ℕ)
    (f : Fin n → X → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, MemLp (f i) (p i) μ)
    (hp0 : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (hptop : ∀ i, p i ≠ ∞)
    (hpreal : ∀ i, 0 < (p i).toReal)
    (hqsum : ∑ i, 2 / (p i).toReal = 1)
    (a : Fin (J + 1) → X → ℝ) (d : Fin J → X → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (d j) μ)
    (hjump : ∀ j x, d j x = a j.succ x - a j.castSucc x)
    (A : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hlocal : ∀ x, ∑ j : Fin J, ∑ k ∈ box n M,
      ‖aux_discreteAverage (N j.succ)
          (fun i ↦ truncOrbit (box n (M + M)) T (f i) x) k -
        aux_discreteAverage (N j.castSucc)
          (fun i ↦ truncOrbit (box n (M + M)) T (f i) x) k‖ₑ
        ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤
        A * ∏ i, eLpNorm
          (truncOrbit (box n (M + M)) T (f i) x)
            (p i) Measure.count ^ 2)
    (haverage : ∀ (x : X) (k : Fin n → ℕ) (q : Fin (J + 1)),
      k ∈ box n M →
      aux_discreteAverage (N q)
          (fun i ↦ truncOrbit (box n (M + M)) T (f i) x) k =
        a q (T k x)) :
    ∑ j, eLpNorm (d j) 2 μ ^ 2 ≤
      A * ((2 ^ n : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * ∏ i, eLpNorm (f i) (p i) μ ^ 2

name: Auto.aux_ErgodicBox.finite_box_ergodic_to_discrete
statement:
theorem finite_box_ergodic_to_discrete
    {X κ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X}
    (B B' : Finset κ) (T : κ → X → X)
    (hT : ∀ k ∈ B, MeasurePreserving (T k) μ μ)
    {J : ℕ} (d : Fin J → X → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (d j) μ)
    (A P : ℝ≥0∞) (D Q : X → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hpoint : ∀ x, ∑ j : Fin J, ∑ k ∈ B,
      ‖d j (T k x)‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℕ) ≤ D x)
    (hdiscrete : ∀ x, D x ≤ A * Q x)
    (hQmeas : AEMeasurable Q μ)
    (hright : ∫⁻ x, Q x ∂μ ≤ (B'.card : ℝ≥0∞) * P) :
    (B.card : ℝ≥0∞) * ∑ j : Fin J, eLpNorm (d j) 2 μ ^ 2 ≤
      A * ((B'.card : ℝ≥0∞) * P)

statement:
theorem realErgodicJumpEnergy_of_finite_sum
    {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] {μ : Measure X} {n J : ℕ}
    (p : Fin n → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hp : ∀ i, 1 < p i ∧ p i < ∞)
    (hsum : (∑ i, ((p i)⁻¹).toReal) = 1 / 2)
    (S : ErgodicSystem X μ n) (N : Fin (J + 1) → ℕ)
    (hN : StrictMono N) (hNpos : ∀ j, 0 < N j)
    (f : Fin n → X → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, MemLp (f i) (p i) μ)
    (A : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hlocal : ∀ x, ∑ j : Fin J,
      ∑ k ∈ box n (N (Fin.last J)),
        ‖aux_discreteAverage (N j.succ)
            (fun i ↦ truncOrbit
              (box n (N (Fin.last J) + N (Fin.last J)))
              (aux_orbit S.transformation) (f i) x) k -
          aux_discreteAverage (N j.castSucc)
            (fun i ↦ truncOrbit
              (box n (N (Fin.last J) + N (Fin.last J)))
              (aux_orbit S.transformation) (f i) x) k‖ₑ ^ (2 : ℝ) ≤
        A * ∏ i, eLpNorm
          (truncOrbit
            (box n (N (Fin.last J) + N (Fin.last J)))
            (aux_orbit S.transformation) (f i) x)
          (p i) Measure.count ^ 2) :
    realErgodicJumpEnergy S N f ≤
      A * ((2 ^ n : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * ∏ i, eLpNorm (f i) (p i) μ ^ 2

theorem aux_discreteJumpEnergy_orbitFunction {X : Type*}

statement:
theorem aux_prismIndex_top_apply (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (i : Fin (n - n + 1)) :
    prismIndex (n := n) (k := n) hn le_rfl i = aux_topIndex n hn

name: Auto.aux_prismLpExponent_eq
statement:
theorem aux_prismLpExponent_eq (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (i : Fin (n - k + 1)) :
    aux_prismLpExponent n k hk hkn i =
      if i.1 < n - k then 2 ^ (k + i.1 + 1) else 2 ^ (k + (n - k))

name: Auto.aux_prismLpExponent_factor_sum
statement:
theorem aux_prismLpExponent_factor_sum (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    ∑ hi : (Fin k → Fin 2) × Fin (n - k + 1),
      ((aux_prismLpExponent n k hk hkn hi.2 : ℝ)⁻¹) = 1

name: Auto.aux_prismLpExponent_simplex_sum
statement:
theorem aux_prismLpExponent_simplex_sum (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) :
    ∑ i : Fin (n - k + 1), ((aux_prismLpExponent n k hk hkn i : ℝ)⁻¹) =
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ k)⁻¹

name: Auto.aux_prismPoint_eq_prismPullback
statement:
theorem aux_prismPoint_eq_prismPullback (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (a : RealVector k) (t : RealVector (n - k)) (u : RealVector k) (s : ℝ)
    (h : Fin k → Fin 2) (i : Fin (n - k + 1)) :
    prismPoint hk hkn (a, a + u) (aux_prismFiber s a t) h i =
      aux_prismPullback n k hkn h i u s (concatVector n k hkn a t)

name: Auto.aux_prismPoint_eq_prismPullbackCoordinates
statement:
theorem aux_prismPoint_eq_prismPullbackCoordinates (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hkn : k ≤ n) (u : RealVector k) (s : ℝ) (z : RealVector n)
    (h : Fin k → Fin 2) (i : Fin (n - k + 1)) :
    prismPoint hk hkn (aux_prismCoordinates n k hkn (u, (s, z))).1
      (aux_prismCoordinates n k hkn (u, (s, z))).2 h i =
        aux_prismPullback n k hkn h i u s z

name: Auto.aux_prismPoint_succ_bridge_cast
statement:
theorem aux_prismPoint_succ_bridge_cast (k d : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (y : RealVector k × RealVector k) (r0 r1 : ℝ) (x : RealVector (d + 1))
    (h : Fin (k + 1) → Fin 2) (i : Fin (d + 1)) :
    prismPoint (n := k + 1 + d) (k := k + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
      (Fin.lastCases r0 (fun l => y.1 l), Fin.lastCases r1 (fun l => y.2 l))
      (aux_newPrismFiber k d x) h (Fin.cast (by omega) i) =
    prismPoint (n := k + 1 + d) (k := k) hk (by omega) y
      (Fin.cons (if h (Fin.last k) = 0 then r0 else r1) (aux_oldPrismTail k d x))
      (fun l => h l.castSucc) (Fin.cast (by omega) i.succ)

name: Auto.aux_prismPoint_top_apply
statement:
theorem aux_prismPoint_top_apply (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (y : RealVector n × RealVector n)
    (x : RealVector (n - n + 1)) (h : Fin n → Fin 2) (i : Fin (n - n + 1)) :
    prismPoint (n := n) (k := n) hn le_rfl y x h i = cubeCorner y h

name: Auto.aux_prismTailMap_succ
statement:
theorem aux_prismTailMap_succ {k d : ℕ} (j : Fin (d + 1)) (s : ℝ)
    (a : RealVector k) (t : RealVector (d + 1)) :
    aux_prismTailMap (Fin.succ j) s a t =
      Fin.cons (s - coordinateSum a - coordinateSum t) (eraseVector j t)

name: Auto.aux_prismTailMap_zero
statement:
theorem aux_prismTailMap_zero {k d : ℕ} (s : ℝ) (a : RealVector k)
    (t : RealVector d) :
    aux_prismTailMap (0 : Fin (d + 1)) s a t = t

name: Auto.aux_prismTailSplitEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem aux_prismTailSplitEquiv_apply (d : ℕ) (j : Fin (d + 1))
    (t : RealVector (d + 1)) :
    aux_prismTailSplitEquiv d j t = (t j, eraseVector j t)

name: Auto.aux_prism_lintegral_le_one
statement:
theorem aux_prism_lintegral_le_one (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n)
    (F : Fin n → SchwartzMap (RealVector n) ℝ) (hF : F ∈ normalizedFunctionTuples n)
    (u : RealVector k) (s : ℝ) :
    ∫⁻ z : RealVector n, ∏ hi : (Fin k → Fin 2) × Fin (n - k + 1),
      ‖F (prismIndex hk hkn hi.2)
        (aux_prismPullback n k hkn hi.1 hi.2 u s z)‖ₑ ∂volume ≤ 1

name: Auto.aux_prism_weight_sum
statement:
theorem aux_prism_weight_sum (m : ℕ) :
    (∑ i : Fin (m + 1),
      (if i.1 < m then ((2 : ℝ) ^ (i.1 + 1))⁻¹ else ((2 : ℝ) ^ m)⁻¹)) = 1

name: Auto.aux_prod_cubeCorners_snoc
statement:
theorem aux_prod_cubeCorners_snoc {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (k : ℕ)
    (f : (Fin (k + 1) → Fin 2) → M) :
    (∏ h : Fin (k + 1) → Fin 2, f h) =
      ∏ h : Fin k → Fin 2, ∏ a : Fin 2, f (Fin.snoc h a)

name: Auto.aux_prod_cubeCorners_snoc_two
statement:
theorem aux_prod_cubeCorners_snoc_two {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M] (k : ℕ)
    (f : (Fin (k + 1) → Fin 2) → M) :
    (∏ h : Fin (k + 1) → Fin 2, f h) =
      ∏ h : Fin k → Fin 2, f (Fin.snoc h 0) * f (Fin.snoc h 1)

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeA2CoordinatesGroupedEquiv_coe
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeA2CoordinatesGroupedEquiv_coe (k d : ℕ) :
    (aux_singlyCancellativeA2CoordinatesGroupedEquiv k d :
      aux_singlyCancellativeA2GroupedSource k d → aux_singlyCancellativeA2Target k d) =
      aux_singlyCancellativeA2CoordinatesGrouped k d

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeA2CoordinatesGrouped_apply
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeA2CoordinatesGrouped_apply (k d : ℕ)
    (y0 y1 : RealVector k) (r0 r1 t : ℝ) (x : RealVector (d + 1)) :
    aux_singlyCancellativeA2CoordinatesGrouped k d ((((y0, r0), (y1, r1)), x), t) =
      (((Fin.lastCases r0 y0, Fin.lastCases r1 y1), r0 - t), x)

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeA2CoordinatesGrouped_cornerProduct
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeA2CoordinatesGrouped_cornerProduct (k d : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (F : Fin (k + 1 + d) → RealVector (k + 1 + d) → ℝ)
    (p : aux_singlyCancellativeA2GroupedSource k d) :
    aux_singlyCancellativeA2TargetCornerProduct k d F
      (aux_singlyCancellativeA2CoordinatesGrouped k d p) =
      aux_singlyCancellativeA2SourceCornerProduct k d hk F p

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeA2SourceSquareReorder_apply
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeA2SourceSquareReorder_apply (k d : ℕ)
    (y0 y1 : RealVector k) (r0 r1 t : ℝ) (x : RealVector (d + 1)) :
    aux_singlyCancellativeA2SourceSquareReorder k d ((((y0, r0), (y1, r1)), x), t) =
      (((y0, y1), (t, aux_oldPrismTail k d x)), (r0, r1))

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeA2_eq_liftPrism
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeA2_eq_liftPrism
    (k d J : ℕ) (hJ : 1 ≤ J) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (rho : Fin J → KKernel k) (phi : Fin J → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hrho : ∀ j, MemW0 (rho j)) (hphi : ∀ j, MemW0 (phi j))
    (F : Fin (k + 1 + d) → SchwartzMap (RealVector (k + 1 + d)) ℝ) :
    (∑ j : Fin J, ∫ p : aux_singlyCancellativeCSPairingSpace (k + 1 + d) k,
      |Real.sqrt |aux_singlyCancellativeCSRawR (k + 1 + d) k (rho j) p| *
        aux_singlyCancellativeCSRawA (k + 1 + d) k hk (by omega) (phi j) F p| ^
          (2 : ℝ)) =
      prismBrascampLiebForm (k + 1 + d) (k + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
        (singlyCancellativeLift k J rho phi) (fun i x => F i x)

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeA2_integral_cornerProduct
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeA2_integral_cornerProduct (k d : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (F : Fin (k + 1 + d) → RealVector (k + 1 + d) → ℝ)
    (G : aux_singlyCancellativeA2Target k d → ℝ) :
    (∫ p : aux_singlyCancellativeA2GroupedSource k d,
      G (aux_singlyCancellativeA2CoordinatesGrouped k d p) *
        aux_singlyCancellativeA2SourceCornerProduct k d hk F p) =
      ∫ z : aux_singlyCancellativeA2Target k d,
        G z * aux_singlyCancellativeA2TargetCornerProduct k d F z

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeA2_kernelFactor_comp_coordinates
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeA2_kernelFactor_comp_coordinates (k d : ℕ)
    (rho : KKernel k) (phi : ℝ → ℝ)
    (p : aux_singlyCancellativeA2GroupedSource k d) :
    aux_singlyCancellativeA2TargetKernelFactor k d rho phi
      (aux_singlyCancellativeA2CoordinatesGrouped k d p) =
        aux_singlyCancellativeA2SourceKernelFactor k d rho phi p

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeA2_raw_coordinate_identity
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeA2_raw_coordinate_identity (k d : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (rho : KKernel k) (phi : ℝ → ℝ)
    (F : Fin (k + 1 + d) → RealVector (k + 1 + d) → ℝ) :
    (∫ p : aux_singlyCancellativeA2GroupedSource k d,
      aux_singlyCancellativeA2SourceKernelFactor k d rho phi p *
        aux_singlyCancellativeA2SourceCornerProduct k d hk F p) =
      ∫ z : aux_singlyCancellativeA2Target k d,
        aux_singlyCancellativeA2TargetKernelFactor k d rho phi z *
          aux_singlyCancellativeA2TargetCornerProduct k d F z

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeA2_sourceCorner_eq_AProduct
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeA2_sourceCorner_eq_AProduct (k d : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (F : Fin (k + 1 + d) → SchwartzMap (RealVector (k + 1 + d)) ℝ)
    (p : aux_singlyCancellativeA2GroupedSource k d) :
    aux_singlyCancellativeA2SourceCornerProduct k d hk (fun i x => F i x) p =
      aux_singlyCancellativeAProduct (k + 1 + d) k hk (by omega) F
        (p.1.1.1.1, p.1.1.2.1) p.1.1.1.2 (aux_oldPrismTail k d p.1.2) *
      aux_singlyCancellativeAProduct (k + 1 + d) k hk (by omega) F
        (p.1.1.1.1, p.1.1.2.1) p.1.1.2.2 (aux_oldPrismTail k d p.1.2)

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeA2_sourceIntegrand_eq_weightedAProduct
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeA2_sourceIntegrand_eq_weightedAProduct (k d : ℕ)
    (hk : 1 ≤ k) (rho : KKernel k) (phi : ℝ → ℝ)
    (F : Fin (k + 1 + d) → SchwartzMap (RealVector (k + 1 + d)) ℝ)
    (s : aux_singlyCancellativeA2GroupedSource k d) :
    aux_singlyCancellativeA2SourceKernelFactor k d rho phi s *
      aux_singlyCancellativeA2SourceCornerProduct k d hk (fun i x => F i x) s =
      aux_singlyCancellativeWeightedAIntegrand (k + 1 + d) k hk (by omega) rho phi F
        ((aux_singlyCancellativeA2SourceSquareReorder k d s).1,
          (aux_singlyCancellativeA2SourceSquareReorder k d s).2.1) *
      aux_singlyCancellativeWeightedAIntegrand (k + 1 + d) k hk (by omega) rho phi F
        ((aux_singlyCancellativeA2SourceSquareReorder k d s).1,
          (aux_singlyCancellativeA2SourceSquareReorder k d s).2.2)

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeA2_weightedSquare_eq_source
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeA2_weightedSquare_eq_source
    (k d : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (rho : KKernel k) (phi : ℝ → ℝ)
    (F : Fin (k + 1 + d) → SchwartzMap (RealVector (k + 1 + d)) ℝ)
    (hsource : Integrable (fun s : aux_singlyCancellativeA2GroupedSource k d =>
      aux_singlyCancellativeA2SourceKernelFactor k d rho phi s *
        aux_singlyCancellativeA2SourceCornerProduct k d hk (fun i x => F i x) s)) :
    (∫ p : aux_singlyCancellativeCSPairingSpace (k + 1 + d) k,
      |Real.sqrt |aux_singlyCancellativeCSRawR (k + 1 + d) k rho p| *
        aux_singlyCancellativeCSRawA (k + 1 + d) k hk (by omega) phi F p| ^ (2 : ℝ)) =
      ∫ s : aux_singlyCancellativeA2GroupedSource k d,
        aux_singlyCancellativeA2SourceKernelFactor k d rho phi s *
          aux_singlyCancellativeA2SourceCornerProduct k d hk (fun i x => F i x) s

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeAProduct_normalize
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeAProduct_normalize (k d : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (F : Fin (k + 1 + d) → SchwartzMap (RealVector (k + 1 + d)) ℝ)
    (y : RealVector k × RealVector k) (r : ℝ) (x : RealVector (d + 1)) :
    aux_singlyCancellativeAProduct (k + 1 + d) k hk (by omega) F y r
      (aux_oldPrismTail k d x) =
      ∏ h : Fin k → Fin 2, ∏ i : Fin (d + 1),
        F (prismIndex hk (by omega) (Fin.cast (by omega) i.succ))
          (prismPoint (n := k + 1 + d) (k := k) hk (by omega) y
            (Fin.cons r (aux_oldPrismTail k d x)) h
            (Fin.cast (by omega) i.succ))

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeB2Original_eq_cubeForm
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeB2Original_eq_cubeForm (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hkn : k < n) (rho : KKernel k) (F : RealVector n → ℝ)
    (hInt : Integrable (aux_singlyCancellativeB2OriginalIntegrand n k hk hkn.le rho F)) :
    (∫ p : (RealVector k × RealVector k) × (ℝ × RealVector (n - k)),
      aux_singlyCancellativeB2OriginalIntegrand n k hk hkn.le rho F p) =
      cubeBrascampLiebForm n k hk hkn.le
        (aux_singlyCancellativeSliceKernel k rho) F

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeB2Original_sum_eq_cubeForm
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeB2Original_sum_eq_cubeForm
    (n k J : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k < n)
    (rho : Fin J → KKernel k) (hrho : ∀ j, MemW0 (rho j))
    (F : Fin n → SchwartzMap (RealVector n) ℝ) :
    (∑ j : Fin J, ∫ p : (RealVector k × RealVector k) ×
        (ℝ × RealVector (n - k)),
      aux_singlyCancellativeB2OriginalIntegrand n k hk hkn.le (rho j)
        (F ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩) p) =
      ∑ j : Fin J, cubeBrascampLiebForm n k hk hkn.le
        (aux_singlyCancellativeSliceKernel k (rho j))
        (F ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩)

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeB2Original_sum_le
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeB2Original_sum_le
    (n k J : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k < n)
    (rho : Fin J → KKernel k) (hrho : ∀ j, MemW0 (rho j))
    (F : Fin n → SchwartzMap (RealVector n) ℝ)
    (hF : F ∈ normalizedFunctionTuples n) :
    (∑ j : Fin J, ∫ p : (RealVector k × RealVector k) ×
        (ℝ × RealVector (n - k)),
      aux_singlyCancellativeB2OriginalIntegrand n k hk hkn.le (rho j)
        (F ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩) p) ≤
      ∑ j : Fin J, (eLpNorm (rho j) 1 volume).toReal

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeB2Reorder_apply
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeB2Reorder_apply (k d : ℕ)
    (y : RealVector k × RealVector k) (t : ℝ) (x : RealVector d) :
    aux_singlyCancellativeB2Reorder k d (y, (t, x)) = ((y, x), t)

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeB2_eq_cubeForm
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeB2_eq_cubeForm (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hkn : k < n) (rho : KKernel k) (F : RealVector n → ℝ)
    (hInt : Integrable (aux_singlyCancellativeB2Integrand n k hk hkn.le rho F)) :
    (∫ p : ((RealVector k × RealVector k) × RealVector (n - k)) × ℝ,
      aux_singlyCancellativeB2Integrand n k hk hkn.le rho F p) =
      cubeBrascampLiebForm n k hk hkn.le
        (aux_singlyCancellativeSliceKernel k rho) F

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeBaseIntegral_eq_rawPairing
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeBaseIntegral_eq_rawPairing (n k : ℕ)
    (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) (rho : KKernel k) (hrho : MemW0 rho)
    (phi : ℝ → ℝ) (hphi : MemW0 phi) (F : Fin n → SchwartzMap (RealVector n) ℝ) :
    (∫ p : (RealVector k × RealVector k) × (ℝ × (ℝ × RealVector (n - k))),
      aux_singlyCancellativeBaseIntegrand n k hk hkn rho phi F p) =
    ∫ p : aux_singlyCancellativeCSPairingSpace n k,
      aux_singlyCancellativeCSRawR n k rho p *
        aux_singlyCancellativeCSRawA n k hk hkn phi F p *
          aux_singlyCancellativeCSRawB n k hk hkn F p

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeCSFubiniIntegrand_comp_reorder
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeCSFubiniIntegrand_comp_reorder (n k : ℕ)
    (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) (rho : KKernel k) (phi : ℝ → ℝ)
    (F : Fin n → SchwartzMap (RealVector n) ℝ) :
    aux_singlyCancellativeCSFubiniIntegrand n k hk hkn rho phi F ∘
      aux_singlyCancellativeCSFubiniReorder n k =
        aux_singlyCancellativeBaseIntegrand n k hk hkn rho phi F

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeCSRawIntegral_apply
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeCSRawIntegral_apply (n k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (hkn : k ≤ n) (rho : KKernel k) (phi : ℝ → ℝ)
    (F : Fin n → SchwartzMap (RealVector n) ℝ)
    (p : aux_singlyCancellativeCSPairingSpace n k) :
    (∫ r : ℝ, aux_singlyCancellativeCSFubiniIntegrand n k hk hkn rho phi F (p, r)) =
      aux_singlyCancellativeCSRawR n k rho p *
        aux_singlyCancellativeCSRawA n k hk hkn phi F p *
          aux_singlyCancellativeCSRawB n k hk hkn F p

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeCS_pairing_cauchy
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeCS_pairing_cauchy
    (n k J : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k < n)
    (rho : Fin J → KKernel k) (phi : Fin J → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hrho : ∀ j, MemW0 (rho j)) (hphi : ∀ j, MemW0 (phi j))
    (F : Fin n → SchwartzMap (RealVector n) ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ j, MemLp (fun p : aux_singlyCancellativeCSPairingSpace n k =>
      Real.sqrt |aux_singlyCancellativeCSRawR n k (rho j) p| *
        aux_singlyCancellativeCSRawA n k hk hkn.le (phi j) F p) 2 volume) :
    |∑ j, ∫ p : aux_singlyCancellativeCSPairingSpace n k,
      aux_singlyCancellativeCSRawR n k (rho j) p *
        aux_singlyCancellativeCSRawA n k hk hkn.le (phi j) F p *
          aux_singlyCancellativeCSRawB n k hk hkn.le F p| ^ 2 ≤
      (∑ j, ∫ p : aux_singlyCancellativeCSPairingSpace n k,
        |Real.sqrt |aux_singlyCancellativeCSRawR n k (rho j) p| *
          aux_singlyCancellativeCSRawA n k hk hkn.le (phi j) F p| ^ (2 : ℝ)) *
        (∑ j, ∫ p : aux_singlyCancellativeCSPairingSpace n k,
          |Real.sqrt |aux_singlyCancellativeCSRawR n k (rho j) p| *
            aux_singlyCancellativeCSRawB n k hk hkn.le F p| ^ (2 : ℝ))

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeLiftA2TargetIntegrand_comp_rawToTarget
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeLiftA2TargetIntegrand_comp_rawToTarget
    (k d : ℕ) (rho : KKernel k) (phi : ℝ → ℝ)
    (F : Fin (k + 1 + d) → RealVector (k + 1 + d) → ℝ) :
    (fun z : aux_singlyCancellativeA2Target k d =>
      aux_singlyCancellativeA2TargetKernelFactor k d rho phi z *
        aux_singlyCancellativeA2TargetCornerProduct k d F z) ∘
        aux_singlyCancellativeLiftA2_rawToTarget k d =
      fun p : ((RealVector (k + 1) × ℝ) × ℝ) × RealVector (k + 1 + d) =>
        aux_singlyCancellativeLiftExpandedKernel k rho phi p.1 *
          ∏ h : Fin (k + 1) → Fin 2,
            ∏ i : Fin (k + 1 + d - (k + 1) + 1),
              F (prismIndex (show 1 ≤ k + 1 by omega) (by omega) i)
                (aux_prismPullback (k + 1 + d) (k + 1) (by omega)
                  h i p.1.1.1 p.1.1.2 p.2)

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeLiftA2_coordinateSum_newPrismFiber
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeLiftA2_coordinateSum_newPrismFiber (k d : ℕ)

    coordinateSum (aux_newPrismFiber k d x) = coordinateSum x

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeLiftA2_coordinateSum_newPrismTailEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeLiftA2_coordinateSum_newPrismTailEquiv_symm
    (k d : ℕ) (x : RealVector (k + 1 + d - (k + 1) + 1)) :

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeLiftA2_newPrismTailEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeLiftA2_newPrismTailEquiv_apply (k d : ℕ)

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeLiftA2_rawToTarget_apply
statement:
theorem aux_singlyCancellativeLiftA2_rawToTarget_apply (k d : ℕ)
    (u : RealVector (k + 1)) (s q : ℝ) (z : RealVector (k + 1 + d)) :
    aux_singlyCancellativeLiftA2_rawToTarget k d (((u, s), q), z) =
      let c := aux_prismCoordinates (k + 1 + d) (k + 1) (by omega) (u, (s, z))
      ((c.1, q), (aux_singlyCancellativeLiftA2_newPrismTailEquiv k d).symm c.2)

name: Auto.aux_singlyCancellativeLiftShear_apply
statement:

    (y : RealVector k × RealVector k) (r0 r1 : ℝ) (x : RealVector (d + 1)) :
    (∏ h : Fin (k + 1) → Fin 2, ∏ i : Fin (d + 1),
      F (prismIndex (show 1 ≤ k + 1 by omega) (by omega) (Fin.cast (by omega) i))
        (prismPoint (n := k + 1 + d) (k := k + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
          (Fin.lastCases r0 (fun l => y.1 l), Fin.lastCases r1 (fun l => y.2 l))
          (aux_newPrismFiber k d x) h (Fin.cast (by omega) i))) =
      (∏ h : Fin k → Fin 2, ∏ i : Fin (d + 1),
        F (prismIndex hk (by omega) (Fin.cast (by omega) i.succ))
          (prismPoint (n := k + 1 + d) (k := k) hk (by omega) y
            (Fin.cons r0 (aux_oldPrismTail k d x)) h (Fin.cast (by omega) i.succ))) *
      (∏ h : Fin k → Fin 2, ∏ i : Fin (d + 1),
        F (prismIndex hk (by omega) (Fin.cast (by omega) i.succ))
          (prismPoint (n := k + 1 + d) (k := k) hk (by omega) y
            (Fin.cons r1 (aux_oldPrismTail k d x)) h (Fin.cast (by omega) i.succ)))

statement:
theorem cauchySchwarzAtK_bound
    (n k J : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hkn : k < n - 1) (hJ : 1 ≤ J)
    (rho : Fin J → MKernel k) (phi : Fin J → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hrho : ∀ j, MemW0 (rho j))
    (hphi : ∀ j, MemW0 (phi j)) (i : Fin k)

    (hF : F ∈ normalizedFunctionTuples n) :
    |prismForm n k hk (by omega)
      (cauchySchwarzKernel rho phi i) (fun a x => F a x)| ≤
      Real.sqrt |prismForm n (k + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
        (cauchySchwarzLift rho phi) (fun a x => F a x)| *
        Real.sqrt (∑ j, (eLpNorm (rho j) 1 volume).toReal)

    (k J : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hJ : 1 ≤ J)
    (rho : Fin J → MKernel k) (phi : Fin J → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hrho : ∀ j, MemW0 (rho j)) (hphi : ∀ j, MemW0 (phi j))

    (hF : F ∈ normalizedFunctionTuples (k + 1)) :
    MemW0 (doublyCauchySchwarzKernel rho phi i) ∧
      MemW0 (cauchySchwarzLift rho phi) ∧
      |prismForm (k + 1) k hk (by omega)
        (doublyCauchySchwarzKernel rho phi i) (fun a x => F a x)| ≤
        sSup (Set.range (fun G : NormalizedFunctionTuple (k + 1) =>
          |prismForm (k + 1) (k + 1) (by omega) le_rfl
            (cauchySchwarzLift rho phi) (fun a x => G.1 a x)|))

theorem aux_mean_gaussian_base_difference (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N)

    (x y : ℝ) :
    ‖FourierTransformInv.fourierInv (gaussianBumpQuotient beta phiHat) (x + y) -
        FourierTransformInv.fourierInv (gaussianBumpQuotient beta phiHat) x‖ ≤
      C_meanValueBumpEstimate N *

    (hs₀ : 0 < s₀) (hs₁ : 0 < s₁) :
    scaledBracketBumpReal n₀ s₀ (inner ℝ x α₀) *
        scaledBracketBumpReal n₁ s₁ (inner ℝ x α₁) ≤
      C_orthogonalDecay α₀ α₁ n₀ n₁ *
        (scaledBracketBumpReal n₀ s₀ (inner ℝ x α₀) *
            scaledBracketBumpReal n₁ s₁
              (inner ℝ x
                ((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).toBasis.orientation.rightAngleRotation α₀)) +
          scaledBracketBumpReal n₀ s₀
              (inner ℝ x
                ((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).toBasis.orientation.rightAngleRotation α₁)) *
            scaledBracketBumpReal n₁ s₁ (inner ℝ x α₁))

name: Auto.orthogonalDomination
statement:
theorem orthogonalDomination

    (hα₀ : ‖α₀‖ = 1) (hα₁ : ‖α₁‖ = 1)
    (hlin : LinearIndependent ℝ ![α₀, α₁]) :
    |inner ℝ x ((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).toBasis.orientation.rightAngleRotation α₀)| ≤
        2 * |inner ℝ α₀
          ((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).toBasis.orientation.rightAngleRotation α₁)|⁻¹ *
          |inner ℝ x α₁| ∨
      |inner ℝ x ((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).toBasis.orientation.rightAngleRotation α₁)| ≤
        2 * |inner ℝ α₀
          ((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 2) ℝ).toBasis.orientation.rightAngleRotation α₁)|⁻¹ *
          |inner ℝ x α₀|

name: Auto.secondGaussianEstimate
statement:
theorem secondGaussianEstimate (c : ℝ) (N : ℕ) (phi phiHat : ℝ → ℂ)
    (_hphiW0 : MemW0 phi) (_hphiHat : phiHat = FourierTransform.fourier phi)
    (hc : 0 < c) (mu lambda t nu : ℝ) (hmu : 0 < mu) (hmulambda : mu ≤ lambda)
    (hlambda : lambda ≤ 1 / 2) (ht : Real.sqrt 3 / 2 ≤ t)
    (hnu : nu ∈ Set.Ico (-1 : ℝ) 0)
    (hplateau : ∀ u ∈ Set.Icc (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) (1 / 2), phiHat u = 1)
    (hphi : ContDiff ℝ N phiHat)
    (hsupp : tsupport phiHat ⊆ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1)
    (hphiBound : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ N → ∀ xi : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv m phiHat xi‖ ≤ c) :
    ContDiff ℝ N (secondGaussianMultiplier phiHat mu lambda t nu) ∧
      ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ N *
        max (∫ xi : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv N (secondGaussianMultiplier phiHat mu lambda t nu) xi‖)
          (sSup (Set.range fun xi : ℝ =>
            ‖iteratedDeriv N (secondGaussianMultiplier phiHat mu lambda t nu) xi‖)) ≤
      c * C_secondGaussianEstimate N

name: Auto.smoothDecay
statement:
theorem smoothDecay (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) (zeta : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hzeta : ContDiff ℝ N zeta) (hzetaSupport : HasCompactSupport zeta) :
    MemW0 (FourierTransformInv.fourierInv zeta) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, x ≠ 0 →
        ‖FourierTransformInv.fourierInv zeta x‖ ≤
          min (∫ xi : ℝ, ‖zeta xi‖)
            ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ ^ N * |x|⁻¹ ^ N *
              ∫ xi : ℝ, ‖iteratedDeriv N zeta xi‖)

name: Auto.smoothDecay2
statement:
theorem smoothDecay2 (N : ℕ) (hN : 2 ≤ N) (zeta : ℝ → ℂ)
    (hzeta : ContDiff ℝ N zeta) (hzetaSupport : HasCompactSupport zeta) :
    MemW0 (FourierTransformInv.fourierInv zeta) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, ‖FourierTransformInv.fourierInv zeta x‖ ≤
        C_smoothDecay2 N *
          max (sSup (Set.range fun xi : ℝ => ‖zeta xi‖))
            ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ ^ N *
              sSup (Set.range fun xi : ℝ => ‖iteratedDeriv N zeta xi‖)) *
          (volume (tsupport zeta)).toReal * bracketBump x ^ N

name: Auto.standardBumpProperties
statement:
theorem standardBumpProperties :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => eLpNorm (standardBumpFinite n - standardBump) 1 volume)
      atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => eLpNorm (standardBumpFinite n - standardBump) ⊤ volume)
      atTop (nhds 0) ∧
    (∃ Phi : SchwartzMap ℝ ℂ, ∀ x : ℝ, Phi x = (standardBump x : ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ ξ : ℝ, ∃ r : ℝ, r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
      FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (standardBump x : ℂ)) ξ = r) ∧
    Function.support (FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (standardBump x : ℂ))) ⊆
      Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ∧
    (∀ ξ ∈ Set.Icc (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) (1 / 2),
      FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (standardBump x : ℂ)) ξ = 1) ∧
    (∀ m N : ℕ, eLpNorm (iteratedDeriv N
      (fun ξ : ℝ => (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * (ξ : ℂ)) ^ m *
        FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (standardBump x : ℂ)) ξ)) ⊤ volume ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (C_standardBumpPropertiesTilde m N)) ∧
    ∀ m N : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv m (fun y : ℝ => (standardBump y : ℂ)) x‖ ≤
        C_standardBumpProperties m N * bracketBump x ^ N

name: Auto.standardBumpProperties_derivativeDecay
statement:
theorem standardBumpProperties_derivativeDecay (m N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) :
    ‖iteratedDeriv m (fun y : ℝ => (standardBump y : ℂ)) x‖ ≤
      C_standardBumpProperties m N * bracketBump x ^ N

name: Auto.standardBumpProperties_fourierDerivativeEstimate
statement:
theorem standardBumpProperties_fourierDerivativeEstimate (m N : ℕ) :
    eLpNorm (iteratedDeriv N
      (fun ξ : ℝ => (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * (ξ : ℂ)) ^ m *
        FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (standardBump x : ℂ)) ξ)) ⊤ volume ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (C_standardBumpPropertiesTilde m N)

name: Auto.standardBumpProperties_fourierShape
statement:
theorem standardBumpProperties_fourierShape :
    (∀ xi : ℝ, ∃ r : ℝ, r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧
      𝓕 (fun x : ℝ => (standardBump x : ℂ)) xi = r) ∧
    Function.support (𝓕 (fun x : ℝ => (standardBump x : ℂ))) ⊆ Set.Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ∧
    ∀ xi ∈ Set.Icc (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) (1 / 2),
      𝓕 (fun x : ℝ => (standardBump x : ℂ)) xi = 1

name: Auto.twoBumpEstimate
statement:
theorem twoBumpEstimate (x₀ x₁ s₀ s₁ n₀ n₁ : ℝ)
    (hs₀ : 0 < s₀) (hs₁ : 0 < s₁) (hs : s₁ ≤ s₀)

    (γ : GeometricParameters n) (hkn : γ.k ≤ n - 1) (ι : MultiplierIndex γ)
    (i : Fin γ.k) (j : ℤ) (hzero : ι.1.1 ≠ 0) (hnegative : ι.1.1 < 0) (u : ℝ) :
    aux_fourierReal (nMultiplierRho γ hkn ι i j) u =
      fourScaleGaussianRhoFrequency
        (FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (standardBump x : ℂ)))
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ ι.1.1 * γ.scales i 1 (j - (geometricDelta γ : ℤ) - 1))
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ ι.1.1 * γ.scales i 1 (j - (geometricDelta γ : ℤ)))
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ ι.1.1 * γ.scales i 1 (j - (geometricDelta γ : ℤ) - 1))
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ (ι.1.1 + 1) * γ.scales i 1 (j - (geometricDelta γ : ℤ) - 1))
        (nMultiplierFourScaleExponent γ) u

name: Auto.aux_gammaGaussian_fourier_diagonal

theorem aux_gammaGaussian_fourier_diagonal {n : ℕ} (γ : GeometricParameters n)

    aux_fourierPlane (gammaGaussian γ i j) (ξ, -ξ) =
      if _h : γ.orientation i = 0 then
        (Auto.gaussian
          (Real.sqrt ((γ.scales i 0 j) ^ 2 + (γ.scales i 1 j) ^ 2) * ξ) : ℂ)
      else
        (Auto.gaussian
          (Real.sqrt 2 * γ.scales i 1 j * ξ) : ℂ)

      lMultiplierAtScale γ ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-(N : ℤ)) *
        γ.scales i 1 (j - (geometricDelta γ : ℤ) - 1)) i j -
      lMultiplierAtScale γ (γ.scales i 1 (j - (geometricDelta γ : ℤ) - 1)) i j

name: Auto.aux_sMultiplier_tensor_fourier_diagonal
statement:
theorem aux_sMultiplier_tensor_fourier_diagonal {n : ℕ}
    (γ : GeometricParameters n) (i : Fin γ.k) (j : ℤ) (ξ : ℝ) :
    aux_fourierPlane (fun v : RealPlane =>
      sMultiplier γ i j v.1 * sMultiplier γ i j v.2) (ξ, -ξ) =
      if _h : γ.orientation i = 0 then
        (Auto.gaussian
          (Real.sqrt ((γ.scales i 0 (j - 1)) ^ 2 + (γ.scales i 1 (j - 1)) ^ 2) * ξ) -
          Auto.gaussian
            (Real.sqrt ((γ.scales i 0 j) ^ 2 + (γ.scales i 1 j) ^ 2) * ξ) : ℂ)
      else
        (Auto.gaussian
          (Real.sqrt 2 * γ.scales i 1 (j - 1) * ξ) -
          Auto.gaussian
            (Real.sqrt 2 * γ.scales i 1 j * ξ) : ℂ)

    (hqu : q.2 = 0) (hq₀ : SpacedSequence (q.1 0))

    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hratio : lam * ((q.1 0 j)⁻¹ + (q.1 1 j)⁻¹) ≤ r)
    (hR : ∀ p : ℝ, |R p| ≤ A * lam * scaledBracketBump 2 lam p)
    (hint : Integrable (fun p : ℝ =>
      scaledBracketBump 2 lam p *
        (((q.1 0 j)⁻¹ + (q.1 1 j)⁻¹) *
          aux_kernelBracketProduct q j (v.1 - p, v.2 - p))))
    (hscalar :
      (∫ p : ℝ, scaledBracketBump 2 lam p *
        (((q.1 0 j)⁻¹ + (q.1 1 j)⁻¹) *
          (scaledBracketBump 2 (q.1 0 j) (v.1 - p) *
            scaledBracketBump 2 (q.1 1 j) (v.2 - p)))) ≤
        9 * C_bumpTriangle 1 1 2 2 * C_twoBumpEstimate 2 2 *
          ((q.1 0 j)⁻¹ + (q.1 1 j)⁻¹) *
          (scaledBracketBump 2 (q.1 0 j) v.1 *
              scaledBracketBump 2 (max lam (q.1 1 j)) v.2 +
            scaledBracketBump 2 lam v.1 *
              scaledBracketBump 2 (max (q.1 0 j) (q.1 1 j)) v.2 +
            scaledBracketBump 2 lam ((v.1 + v.2) / Real.sqrt 2) *
              scaledBracketBump 2 (max (q.1 0 j) (q.1 1 j))
                ((v.1 - v.2) / Real.sqrt 2))) :
    (∫ p : ℝ, |R p| *
      (((q.1 0 j)⁻¹ + (q.1 1 j)⁻¹) *
        aux_kernelBracketProduct q j (v.1 - p, v.2 - p))) ≤
      9 * A * r * C_bumpTriangle 1 1 2 2 * C_twoBumpEstimate 2 2 *
        (scaledBracketBump 2 (q.1 0 j) v.1 *
            scaledBracketBump 2 (max lam (q.1 1 j)) v.2 +
          scaledBracketBump 2 lam v.1 *
            scaledBracketBump 2 (max (q.1 0 j) (q.1 1 j)) v.2 +
          scaledBracketBump 2 lam ((v.1 + v.2) / Real.sqrt 2) *
            scaledBracketBump 2 (max (q.1 0 j) (q.1 1 j))
              ((v.1 - v.2) / Real.sqrt 2))

    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)

    (hp_top : ∀ i, p i ≠ ∞)
    (hint : ∀ i, (p i)⁻¹ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ) * (p₀ i)⁻¹ +
      ENNReal.ofReal θ * (p₁ i)⁻¹)
    (g : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
    (hg : ∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ)
    (hgnorm : ∀ i, eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (p i.succ) μ ≤ 1) :
    (∀ i, aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g (θ : ℂ) i = g i) ∧
    (∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) i,

    (∀ (t : ℝ) i, eLpNorm
      (aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i : X → ℂ)
        (p₀ i.succ) μ ≤ 1) ∧
    (∀ (t : ℝ) i, eLpNorm
      (aux_multilinear_input_deformation p₀ p₁ p g (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i : X → ℂ)
        (p₁ i.succ) μ ≤ 1)

    {m : ℕ} {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} [SigmaFinite ν]
    (B : SimpleFunc X ℂ → (Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ) → Y → ℂ)
    {p₀ p₁ p : Fin (m + 1) → ENNReal} {q : ENNReal} {θ M₀ M₁ : ℝ}
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hp₀ : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p₀ i) (hp₁ : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p₁ i) (hq : 1 ≤ q)
    (hint : (p 0)⁻¹ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ) * (p₀ 0)⁻¹ +
      ENNReal.ofReal θ * (p₁ 0)⁻¹)
    (hM₀ : 0 < M₀) (hM₁ : 0 < M₁)
    (hB_add : ∀ (f g : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → Integrable (g : X → ℂ) μ →
        B (f + g) u = B f u + B g u)
    (hB_smul : ∀ (c : ℂ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → B (c • f) u = c • B f u)
    (hB_measurable : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) →
        Measurable (B f u))
    (hB_pair_integrable : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
      (g : SimpleFunc Y ℂ), Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ →
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) → Integrable (g : Y → ℂ) ν →
        Integrable (fun y ↦ B f u y * g y) ν)
    (hB_bound₀ : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) →
      eLpNorm (B f u) q ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M₀ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) (p₀ 0) μ *
        ∏ i, eLpNorm (u i : X → ℂ) (p₀ i.succ) μ)
    (hB_bound₁ : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (u : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) →
      eLpNorm (B f u) q ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M₁ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) (p₁ 0) μ *
        ∏ i, eLpNorm (u i : X → ℂ) (p₁ i.succ) μ)
    (g₀ : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g : Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
    (hg₀ : Integrable (g₀ : X → ℂ) μ)
    (D : ℂ → Fin m → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
    (hD_theta : ∀ i, D (θ : ℂ) i = g i)
    (hD_integrable : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) i,
      Integrable (D z i : X → ℂ) μ)
    (hD_left : ∀ (t : ℝ) i,
      eLpNorm (D ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i : X → ℂ) (p₀ i.succ) μ ≤ 1)
    (hD_right : ∀ (t : ℝ) i,
      eLpNorm (D (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) i : X → ℂ) (p₁ i.succ) μ ≤ 1)
    (hB_analytic : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g' : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → Integrable (g' : Y → ℂ) ν →
      DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z ↦ ∫ y, B f (D z) y * g' y ∂ν) (verticalStrip 0 1))
    (hB_growth : ∃ a : ℝ, a < Real.pi ∧
      ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g' : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
        Integrable (f : X → ℂ) μ → Integrable (g' : Y → ℂ) ν →
        ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1,
          ‖∫ y, B f (D z) y * g' y ∂ν‖ ≤
            Real.exp (C * Real.exp (a * |(z : ℂ).im|))) :
    MemLp (B g₀ g) q ν ∧
      eLpNorm (B g₀ g) q ν ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.rpow M₀ (1 - θ) * Real.rpow M₁ θ) *
          eLpNorm (g₀ : X → ℂ) (p 0) μ

    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} [SigmaFinite ν]
    (B : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ SimpleFunc X ℂ) (Y → ℂ))
    (q : ENNReal) (hq : 1 ≤ q) (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A)
    (hB_measurable : ∀ u : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) → Measurable (B u))
    (hB_pair_integrable : ∀ (u : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
      (h : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) → Integrable (h : Y → ℂ) ν →
        Integrable (fun y ↦ B u y * h y) ν)
    (S : Set (Fin (m + 1) → ℝ))
    (hSbox : ∀ u ∈ S, ∀ i, 0 < u i ∧ u i ≤ 1)
    (hendpoint : ∀ u ∈ S, ∀ g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ) →
        eLpNorm (B g) q ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal A * ∏ i,
          eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i) μ)
    (hzero : ∀ (u : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 < u i ∧ u i ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ) (i : Fin (m + 1)),
        eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i) μ = 0 →
          eLpNorm (B g) q ν = 0)
    (u : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (hu : u ∈ convexHull ℝ S)
    (g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
    (hg : ∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ) :
    eLpNorm (B g) q ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal A * ∏ i,
      eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i) μ

    (u : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (hu : u ∈ convexHull ℝ S)
    (g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
    (hg : ∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ) :
    ‖B g‖ₑ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal A * ∏ i,

name: Auto.multilinear_interpolation_two_endpoint
statement:
theorem multilinear_interpolation_two_endpoint
    {m : ℕ} {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} [SigmaFinite ν]
    (B : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ SimpleFunc X ℂ) (Y → ℂ))
    {p₀ p₁ p : Fin (m + 1) → ENNReal} {q : ENNReal} {θ M₀ M₁ : ℝ}
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hp₀ : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p₀ i) (hp₁ : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p₁ i) (hp : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p i)
    (hp_top : ∀ i, p i ≠ ∞)
    (hint : ∀ i, (p i)⁻¹ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ) * (p₀ i)⁻¹ +
      ENNReal.ofReal θ * (p₁ i)⁻¹)
    (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hM₀ : 0 < M₀) (hM₁ : 0 < M₁)
    (hB_measurable : ∀ u : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) → Measurable (B u))
    (hB_pair_integrable : ∀ (u : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
      (h : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) → Integrable (h : Y → ℂ) ν →
        Integrable (fun y ↦ B u y * h y) ν)
    (hB_bound₀ : ∀ u : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) →
        eLpNorm (B u) q ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M₀ * ∏ i,
          eLpNorm (u i : X → ℂ) (p₀ i) μ)
    (hB_bound₁ : ∀ u : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ,
      (∀ i, Integrable (u i : X → ℂ) μ) →
        eLpNorm (B u) q ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M₁ * ∏ i,
          eLpNorm (u i : X → ℂ) (p₁ i) μ)
    (hzero : ∀ (u : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ) (i : Fin (m + 1)),
      eLpNorm (u i : X → ℂ) (p i) μ = 0 → eLpNorm (B u) q ν = 0)
    (g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
    (hg : ∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ) :
    eLpNorm (B g) q ν ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.rpow M₀ (1 - θ) * Real.rpow M₁ θ) *
        eLpNorm (g 0 : X → ℂ) (p 0) μ *
          ∏ i : Fin m, eLpNorm (g i.succ : X → ℂ) (p i.succ) μ

name: Auto.riesz_thorin
statement:
theorem riesz_thorin
    {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} [SigmaFinite ν]
    {p₀ p₁ p q₀ q₁ q : ENNReal} {θ M₀ M₁ : ℝ}
    (T : SimpleFunc X ℂ → Y → ℂ)
    (hp₀ : 1 ≤ p₀) (hp₁ : 1 ≤ p₁) (hq₀ : 1 ≤ q₀) (hq₁ : 1 ≤ q₁)
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hp : p⁻¹ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ) * p₀⁻¹ + ENNReal.ofReal θ * p₁⁻¹)
    (hq : q⁻¹ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ) * q₀⁻¹ + ENNReal.ofReal θ * q₁⁻¹)
    (hT_add : ∀ (f g : SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → Integrable g μ → T (f + g) = T f + T g)
    (hT_smul : ∀ (c : ℂ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → T (c • f) = c • T f)
    (hT_measurable : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → Measurable (T f))
    (hM₀ : 0 < M₀) (hM₁ : 0 < M₁)
    (hbound₀ : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ), Integrable f μ →

    (hbound₁ : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ), Integrable f μ →
      eLpNorm (T f) q₁ ν ≤ ENNReal.ofReal M₁ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) p₁ μ) :
    ∀ f : SimpleFunc X ℂ, Integrable f μ →
      MemLp (T f) q ν ∧
      eLpNorm (T f) q ν ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.rpow M₀ (1 - θ) * Real.rpow M₁ θ) *
          eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) p μ

name: Auto.stein_interpolation
statement:
theorem stein_interpolation
    {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} [SigmaFinite ν]
    {p₀ p₁ p q₀ q₁ q : ENNReal} {θ : ℝ} {M₀ M₁ : ℝ → ℝ}
    (T : ℂ → SimpleFunc X ℂ → Y → ℂ)
    (hp₀ : 1 ≤ p₀) (hp₁ : 1 ≤ p₁) (hq₀ : 1 ≤ q₀) (hq₁ : 1 ≤ q₁)
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1)
    (hp : p⁻¹ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ) * p₀⁻¹ + ENNReal.ofReal θ * p₁⁻¹)
    (hq : q⁻¹ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ) * q₀⁻¹ + ENNReal.ofReal θ * q₁⁻¹)
    (hT_add : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) (f g : SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → Integrable g μ → T z (f + g) = T z f + T z g)
    (hT_smul : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) (c : ℂ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → T z (c • f) = c • T z f)
    (hT_measurable : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → Measurable (T z f))
    (hpair_integrable : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1)
      (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → Integrable g ν → Integrable (fun y ↦ T z f y * g y) ν)
    (hanalytic : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → Integrable g ν →
      DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z ↦ ∫ y, T z f y * g y ∂ν) (verticalStrip 0 1))
    (hfamily_growth : ∃ a : ℝ, a < Real.pi ∧
      ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
        Integrable f μ → Integrable g ν →
        ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1,
          ‖∫ y, T z f y * g y ∂ν‖ ≤ exp (C * exp (a * |(z : ℂ).im|)))
    (hM_measurable : Measurable M₀ ∧ Measurable M₁)
    (hM_pos : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < M₀ t ∧ 0 < M₁ t)
    (hM_growth : ∃ b A : ℝ, b < Real.pi ∧ ∀ t : ℝ,
      |log (M₀ t)| ≤ A * exp (b * |t|) ∧ |log (M₁ t)| ≤ A * exp (b * |t|))
    (hbound₀ : ∀ (t : ℝ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ), Integrable f μ →
      eLpNorm (T ((t : ℂ) * Complex.I) f) q₀ ν ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (M₀ t) * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) p₀ μ)
    (hbound₁ : ∀ (t : ℝ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ), Integrable f μ →
      eLpNorm (T (1 + (t : ℂ) * Complex.I) f) q₁ ν ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (M₁ t) * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) p₁ μ) :
    ∀ f : SimpleFunc X ℂ, Integrable f μ →
      MemLp (T (θ : ℂ) f) q ν ∧
      eLpNorm (T (θ : ℂ) f) q ν ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal
          (exp
            ((sin (Real.pi * θ) / 2) *
              ∫ t : ℝ,
                log (M₀ t) / (cosh (Real.pi * t) - cos (Real.pi * θ)) +
                  log (M₁ t) / (cosh (Real.pi * t) + cos (Real.pi * θ)))) *
          eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) p μ

    (hT_add : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) (f g : SimpleFunc X ℂ),

    (hT_smul : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) (c : ℂ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ),

    (hT_measurable : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ),

    (hpair_integrable : ∀ (z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1)
      (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → Integrable g ν → Integrable (fun y ↦ T z f y * g y) ν)
    (hanalytic : ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),
      Integrable f μ → Integrable g ν →
      DiffContOnCl ℂ (fun z ↦ ∫ y, T z f y * g y ∂ν) (verticalStrip 0 1))
    (hfamily_growth : ∃ a : ℝ, a < Real.pi ∧
      ∀ (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ) (g : SimpleFunc Y ℂ),

        ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z : verticalClosedStrip 0 1,

    (hbound₀ : ∀ (t : ℝ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ), Integrable f μ →

    (hbound₁ : ∀ (t : ℝ) (f : SimpleFunc X ℂ), Integrable f μ →

        ENNReal.ofReal M₁ * eLpNorm (f : X → ℂ) p₁ μ) :
    ∀ f : SimpleFunc X ℂ, Integrable f μ →
      MemLp (T (θ : ℂ) f) q ν ∧
      eLpNorm (T (θ : ℂ) f) q ν ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.rpow M₀ (1 - θ) * Real.rpow M₁ θ) *

name: Auto.aToLambda
statement:
theorem aToLambda {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (phi : SchwartzMap ℝ ℝ)
    (f : Fin n → SchwartzMap (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℝ) :
    ∃ F : Fin n → SchwartzMap (RealVector n) ℝ,
      (∀ i, ∀ p : ℝ≥0∞, eLpNorm (F i) p volume = eLpNorm (f i) p volume) ∧
      eLpNorm (twistedAverage phi (fun i x ↦ f i x)) 2 volume ^ 2 =
        ENNReal.ofReal
          (prismForm n 1 (by omega) hn
            (fun y ↦ phi (y.1 0) * phi (y.2 0))
            (fun i x ↦ F i x))

name: Auto.aToLambda_fin_sum
statement:
theorem aToLambda_fin_sum {n J : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (phi : Fin J → SchwartzMap ℝ ℝ)
    (f : Fin n → SchwartzMap (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℝ) :
    ∃ F : Fin n → SchwartzMap (RealVector n) ℝ,
      (∀ i, ∀ p : ℝ≥0∞, eLpNorm (F i) p volume = eLpNorm (f i) p volume) ∧
      (∑ j, eLpNorm (twistedAverage (phi j) (fun i x ↦ f i x)) 2 volume ^ 2) =
        ENNReal.ofReal
          (prismForm n 1 (by omega) hn
            (fun y ↦ ∑ j, phi j (y.1 0) * phi j (y.2 0))
            (fun i x ↦ F i x))

theorem aToLambda_transformed {d : ℕ} (phi : SchwartzMap ℝ ℝ)

      ENNReal.ofReal
        (prismForm (d + 1) 1 (by omega) (by omega)
          (fun y ↦ phi (y.1 0) * phi (y.2 0))
          (fun i x ↦ transformedFunctions f i x))

name: Auto.aux_aToLambda.rankOneRawIntegrand_eq_global
statement:
lemma rankOneRawIntegrand_eq_global {d : ℕ}
    (phi : SchwartzMap ℝ ℝ)

name: Auto.thetaTOffcenter
statement:
theorem thetaTOffcenter (k : ℤ) (hk : k ≤ -1) (v₀ v₁ : ℝ) :
    Real.rpow 2 ((k : ℝ) / 2) *
        ∫ t : ℝ in Set.Icc 1 2,
          bracketBump (v₀ - t * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-k))) ^ 2 *
            bracketBump (v₁ - t * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-k))) ^ 2 ≤
      C_thetaTOffcenter *
        (Real.rpow (bracketBump v₀) (3 / 2 : ℝ) *
            Real.rpow (bracketBump v₁) (3 / 2 : ℝ) +
          Real.rpow (bracketBump (v₀ + v₁)) (3 / 2 : ℝ) *
            Real.rpow (bracketBump (v₀ - v₁)) (3 / 2 : ℝ))

theorem ftcCsR (J : ℕ) {α β : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hαβ : α < β)
    (a : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 a (Set.Icc α β)) :
    finiteVariationSeminorm (fun t : Set.Icc α β ↦ a t) 2 J ≤
      (ENNReal.ofReal ((β - α) / α)) ^ ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹) *
        aux_logarithmicL2 α β (fun t ↦ t * deriv a t) ∧
    (finiteVariationSeminorm (fun t : Set.Icc α β ↦ a t) 2 J) ^ (2 : ℝ) ≤
      8 * aux_logarithmicL2 α β a *
        aux_logarithmicL2 α β (fun t ↦ t * deriv a t)

name: Auto.shortlongJumps
statement:
theorem shortlongJumps {B : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup B]
    (a : ℝ → B) (J : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) :
    (∀ (t : Fin (J + 1) → ℝ), Monotone t → (∀ j, 0 < t j) →
      ∃ κ : Finset ℤ,
        (∀ k, k ∈ κ ↔ ∃ j, (2 : ℝ) ^ k ≤ t j ∧ t j < (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) ∧
        (∑ j : Fin J,
          (‖a (t j.succ) - a (t j.castSucc)‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ r) ^ r⁻¹ ≤
          2 * (∑ k ∈ κ,
            (finiteVariationSeminorm (fun s : aux_dyadicInterval k ↦ a s) r J) ^ r) ^ r⁻¹ +
          finiteVariationSeminorm
            (fun s : Set.range (fun k : ℤ ↦ (2 : ℝ) ^ k) ↦ a s) r J) ∧
    finiteVariationSeminorm (fun s : Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) ↦ a s) r J ≤
      2 * (∑' k : ℤ,
        (finiteVariationSeminorm (fun s : aux_dyadicInterval k ↦ a s) r J) ^ r) ^ r⁻¹ +
      finiteVariationSeminorm
        (fun s : Set.range (fun k : ℤ ↦ (2 : ℝ) ^ k) ↦ a s) r J

      ‖iteratedDeriv m A xi‖ ≤ c)
    (hBcompact : HasCompactSupport B) (hBsmooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) B)
    (hBreal : ∀ xi : ℝ, ∃ r : ℝ, r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ B xi = r)

    (hqdef : ∀ x, q x = √(2 * theta x ^ 2 - p x))
    (hrad : ∀ x, 0 ≤ 2 * theta x ^ 2 - p x)
    (hqcompact : HasCompactSupport q)
    (hqsmooth : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) q)

    (hthetaC : ∀ x, thetaC x = (theta x : ℂ))

    ∃ psi : SchwartzMap ℝ ℝ,
      (∀ x : ℝ,
        FourierTransform.fourier (fun y : ℝ => (psi y : ℂ)) x ^ 2 =
          2 * thetaC x ^ 2 - pC x) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, psi (-x) = psi x) ∧
      Function.support (FourierTransform.fourier (fun y : ℝ => (psi y : ℂ))) ⊆ K ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, m < 3 → ∀ x : ℝ,
        ‖iteratedDeriv m

name: Auto.phiJProperties
statement:
theorem phiJProperties (phi0 phi1 : SchwartzMap ℝ ℝ) (hpair : uniPair phi0 phi1)
    (Psi : SchwartzMap (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) ℝ) (hPsi : Psi ≠ 0)
    (hsym : ∀ u, Psi u = Psi (WithLp.toLp 2 ![u 1, u 0]))
    (hpos : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, Auto.aux_bounded g →
      0 ≤ ∫ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), g (u 0) * g (u 1) * Psi u)
    (hsupp : Function.support
      (FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) ↦ (Psi x : ℂ))) ⊆
        Auto.aux_productSet
          (Auto.aux_annulusOne 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ 3)))
    (hderiv : ∀ m : ℕ, m < 3 → ∀ xi : ℝ,
      ‖iteratedDeriv m
        (fun z : ℝ ↦ FourierTransform.fourier
          (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) ↦ (Psi x : ℂ))
          (WithLp.toLp 2 ![z, -z])) xi‖ ≤ 1) :
    ∃ psi : SchwartzMap ℝ ℝ,
      (∀ xi : ℝ,
        FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ ↦ (psi x : ℂ)) xi ^ 2 =
          2 * (FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ ↦ (phi0 x : ℂ)) (2 ^ (-5 : ℤ) * xi) -
            FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ ↦ (phi1 x : ℂ)) (2 ^ (5 : ℤ) * xi)) ^ 2 -
            FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) ↦ (Psi x : ℂ))
              (WithLp.toLp 2 ![xi, -xi])) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, psi (-x) = psi x) ∧
      Function.support (FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ ↦ (psi x : ℂ))) ⊆
        Auto.aux_annulusOne 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ 6) ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, m < 3 → ∀ xi : ℝ,
        ‖iteratedDeriv m
          (FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ ↦ (psi x : ℂ))) xi‖ ≤
            C_phiJProperties)

    scaledBracketBumpReal (7 / 6 : ℝ) (aux_reductionBracketLambda D h j)
        (Real.sqrt 2 * w0) *

    scaledBracketBumpReal (7 / 6 : ℝ) (aux_reductionBracketLambda D h j)
        (w0 - w1) *
      scaledBracketBumpReal (7 / 6 : ℝ) (q.right j) (w0 + w1) +
    scaledBracketBumpReal (7 / 6 : ℝ) (q.left j) (w0 - w1) *
      scaledBracketBumpReal (7 / 6 : ℝ) (aux_reductionBracketLambda D h j)
        (w0 + w1) +
    scaledBracketBumpReal (7 / 6 : ℝ) (aux_reductionBracketLambda D h j)
        (Real.sqrt 2 * w0) *
      scaledBracketBumpReal (7 / 6 : ℝ) (q.right j) (Real.sqrt 2 * w1) +
    scaledBracketBumpReal (7 / 6 : ℝ) (aux_reductionBracketLambda D h j)
        (Real.sqrt 2 * w0) *
      scaledBracketBumpReal (7 / 6 : ℝ) (q.left j) (Real.sqrt 2 * w1) ≤

        scaledBracketBumpReal (7 / 6 : ℝ) (q.right j) (w0 + w1) +

statement:
theorem aux_nonWhitneyCorrection_decay
    (a : ℤ → ℝ) (ha : SpacedSequence a) (phi0 phi1 : SchwartzMap ℝ ℝ)
    (hpair : uniPair phi0 phi1) (j : ℤ) (v : RealPlane) :
    |aux_nonWhitneyCorrection phi0 phi1 a j v| ≤
      aux_nonWhitneyCorrectionConstant *
        (scaledBracketBumpReal (3 / 2 : ℝ) (aux_nonWhitneyPrev a j) v.1 *
            scaledBracketBumpReal (3 / 2 : ℝ) (aux_nonWhitneyPrev a j) v.2 +
          scaledBracketBumpReal (3 / 2 : ℝ) (aux_nonWhitneyPrev a j) v.1 *
            scaledBracketBumpReal (3 / 2 : ℝ) (aux_nonWhitneyBase a j) v.2 +
          scaledBracketBumpReal (3 / 2 : ℝ) (aux_nonWhitneyBase a j) v.1 *
            scaledBracketBumpReal (3 / 2 : ℝ) (aux_nonWhitneyPrev a j) v.2 +

name: Auto.aux_nonWhitneyCorrection_decay_two
statement:

      aux_nonWhitneyDecayConstant ^ 2 *
        ((scaledBracketBump 2 (a (j - 1)) v.1 + scaledBracketBump 2 (a j) v.1) *
          (scaledBracketBump 2 (a (j - 1)) v.2 + scaledBracketBump 2 (a j) v.2) +
          scaledBracketBump 2 (a (j - 1)) v.1 * scaledBracketBump 2 (a (j - 1)) v.2 +
          scaledBracketBump 2 (a j) v.1 * scaledBracketBump 2 (a j) v.2)

name: Auto.aux_nonWhitneyCorrection_eq_tensor_form

          aux_windowRescale phi1 (a j) x) v -

statement:
theorem aux_nonWhitneyCorrection_fourierPlane_formula

        aux_fourierReal (fun x => aux_windowRescale phi0 (a (j - 1)) x -
          aux_windowRescale phi1 (a j) x) eta +
      aux_fourierReal (aux_windowRescale phi0 (a j)) xi *
        aux_fourierReal (aux_windowRescale phi0 (a j)) eta -
      aux_fourierReal (aux_windowRescale phi0 (a (j - 1))) xi *

statement:
theorem aux_nonWhitneyCorrection_planeFourier_formula
    (a : ℤ → ℝ) (ha : SpacedSequence a) (phi0 phi1 : SchwartzMap ℝ ℝ)
    (j : ℤ) (xi : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    aux_planeFourier (aux_nonWhitneyCorrection phi0 phi1 a j) xi =
      FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ =>
          ((aux_windowRescale phi0 (a (j - 1)) x - aux_windowRescale phi1 (a j) x : ℝ) : ℂ))
          (xi 0) *
        FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ =>
          ((aux_windowRescale phi0 (a (j - 1)) x - aux_windowRescale phi1 (a j) x : ℝ) : ℂ))
          (xi 1) +
      FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (aux_windowRescale phi0 (a j) x : ℂ))
          (xi 0) *
        FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (aux_windowRescale phi0 (a j) x : ℂ))
          (xi 1) -
      FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (aux_windowRescale phi0 (a (j - 1)) x : ℂ))
          (xi 0) *
        FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (aux_windowRescale phi0 (a (j - 1)) x : ℂ))
          (xi 1)

theorem aux_nonWhitney_tensor_correction_decay
    (f g h : ℝ → ℝ) (K P0 P1 Q0 Q1 : ℝ)
    (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hP0 : 0 ≤ P0) (hP1 : 0 ≤ P1)
    (hQ0 : 0 ≤ Q0) (hQ1 : 0 ≤ Q1) (v : RealPlane)
    (hf0 : |f v.1| ≤ K * P0) (hf1 : |f v.2| ≤ K * P1)
    (hg0 : |g v.1| ≤ K * Q0) (hg1 : |g v.2| ≤ K * Q1)
    (hh0 : |h v.1| ≤ K * Q0) (hh1 : |h v.2| ≤ K * Q1) :
    |tensorSquare (fun x => f x - g x) v -
        (tensorSquare f v - tensorSquare h v)| ≤
      K ^ 2 * ((P0 + Q0) * (P1 + Q1) + P0 * P1 + Q0 * Q1)

statement:
theorem aux_whitneyM3_cancellation_of_square_identity
    (K : RealPlane → ℝ) (p f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hK : MemW0 K) (hp : MemW0 p) (hf : MemW0 f)
    (xi : ℝ)
    (hpeven : aux_fourierReal p (-xi) = aux_fourierReal p xi)
    (hfeven : aux_fourierReal f (-xi) = aux_fourierReal f xi)
    (hsquare : aux_fourierReal p xi ^ 2 =
      2 * aux_fourierReal f xi ^ 2 - aux_fourierPlane K (xi, -xi)) :
    aux_fourierPlane
      (fun v => K v - (2 * tensorSquare f v - tensorSquare p v)) (xi, -xi) = 0

name: Auto.aux_whitneyM3_decay
statement:
theorem aux_whitneyM3_decay
    (a : ℤ → ℝ) (ha : SpacedSequence a)
    (phi0 phi1 psi : SchwartzMap ℝ ℝ) (hpair : uniPair phi0 phi1)
    (Psi : WhitneyKernelData)
    (hpsiDecay : ∀ x : ℝ,
      |psi x| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ 9 * C_phiJProperties * bracketBump x ^ 2)
    (j : ℤ) (v : RealPlane) :
    |aux_planeRescale (a j) Psi.kernel v -
        (2 * tensorSquare (fun x =>
            aux_windowRescale phi0 ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-5 : ℤ) * a j) x -
              aux_windowRescale phi1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ (5 : ℤ) * a j) x) v -
          tensorSquare (aux_windowRescale psi (a j)) v)| ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ 19 * (C_uniPair ^ 2 + C_phiJProperties ^ 2) *
        ∑ u : Fin 2,
          scaledBracketBumpReal (3 / 2 : ℝ) (a j) ((W u v).1) *
            scaledBracketBumpReal (3 / 2 : ℝ) (a j) ((W u v).2)

name: Auto.aux_whitneyM3_fourierPlane_formula
statement:
theorem aux_whitneyM3_fourierPlane_formula

    (xi eta : ℝ) :
    aux_fourierPlane
      (fun v => K v - (2 * tensorSquare f v - tensorSquare p v)) (xi, eta) =

name: Auto.aux_whitneyM3_fourier_zero_of_coordinate_kill
statement:
theorem aux_whitneyM3_fourier_zero_of_coordinate_kill
    (K : RealPlane → ℝ) (p f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (hformula : aux_planeFourier
      (fun v => K v - (2 * tensorSquare f v - tensorSquare p v)) z =
        aux_planeFourier K z -
          (2 * (FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (f x : ℂ)) (z 0) *
              FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (f x : ℂ)) (z 1)) -
            FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (p x : ℂ)) (z 0) *
              FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (p x : ℂ)) (z 1)))
    (q : Fin 2)
    (hKzero : aux_planeFourier K z = 0)
    (hpzero : FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (p x : ℂ)) (z q) = 0)
    (hfzero : FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (f x : ℂ)) (z q) = 0) :
    aux_planeFourier
      (fun v => K v - (2 * tensorSquare f v - tensorSquare p v)) z = 0

name: Auto.aux_whitneyM3_square_identity
statement:
theorem aux_whitneyM3_square_identity
    (a : ℤ → ℝ) (ha : SpacedSequence a)
    (phi0 phi1 psi : SchwartzMap ℝ ℝ) (Psi : WhitneyKernelData)
    (hpsi : ∀ z : ℝ,
      FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (psi x : ℂ)) z ^ 2 =
        2 * (FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (phi0 x : ℂ))
              ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-5 : ℤ) * z) -
          FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (phi1 x : ℂ))
              ((2 : ℝ) ^ (5 : ℤ) * z)) ^ 2 -
          FourierTransform.fourier
            (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => (Psi.kernel_schwartz x : ℂ))
            (WithLp.toLp 2 ![z, -z]))
    (j : ℤ) (xi : ℝ) :
    aux_fourierReal (aux_windowRescale psi (a j)) xi ^ 2 =
      2 * aux_fourierReal
        (fun x => aux_windowRescale phi0 ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-5 : ℤ) * a j) x -
          aux_windowRescale phi1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ (5 : ℤ) * a j) x) xi ^ 2 -
        aux_fourierPlane (aux_planeRescale (a j) Psi.kernel) (xi, -xi)

name: Auto.aux_whitneyM3_support_of_formula_and_kills
statement:
theorem aux_whitneyM3_support_of_formula_and_kills
    (K : RealPlane → ℝ) (p f : ℝ → ℝ) {s t : ℝ}
    (hs : 0 < s) (ht : 0 < t) (hgap : (2 : ℝ) ^ 11 * s ≤ t)
    (hformula : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      aux_planeFourier (fun v => K v - (2 * tensorSquare f v - tensorSquare p v)) z =
        aux_planeFourier K z -
          (2 * (FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (f x : ℂ)) (z 0) *
              FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (f x : ℂ)) (z 1)) -
            FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (p x : ℂ)) (z 0) *
              FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (p x : ℂ)) (z 1)))
    (hKkill : ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (q : Fin 2),
      64 * t⁻¹ < |z q| → aux_planeFourier K z = 0)
    (hpkill : ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (q : Fin 2),
      64 * t⁻¹ < |z q| →
        FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (p x : ℂ)) (z q) = 0)
    (hfkill : ∀ (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (q : Fin 2),
      64 * t⁻¹ < |z q| →
        FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ => (f x : ℂ)) (z q) = 0) :
    Function.support (aux_planeFourier
      (fun v => K v - (2 * tensorSquare f v - tensorSquare p v))) ⊆
      {z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) |
        |z 0 + z 1| ≤ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ * s⁻¹}

name: Auto.aux_whitney_phiJProperties
statement:
theorem aux_whitney_phiJProperties
    (phi0 phi1 : SchwartzMap ℝ ℝ) (hpair : uniPair phi0 phi1)
    (Psi : WhitneyKernelData) :
    ∃ psi : SchwartzMap ℝ ℝ,
      (∀ xi : ℝ,
        FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ ↦ (psi x : ℂ)) xi ^ 2 =
          2 * (FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ ↦ (phi0 x : ℂ))
            ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-5 : ℤ) * xi) -
            FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ ↦ (phi1 x : ℂ))
              ((2 : ℝ) ^ (5 : ℤ) * xi)) ^ 2 -
            FourierTransform.fourier
              (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) ↦ (Psi.kernel_schwartz x : ℂ))
              (WithLp.toLp 2 ![xi, -xi])) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, psi (-x) = psi x) ∧
      Function.support (FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ ↦ (psi x : ℂ))) ⊆
        aux_annulusOne 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ 6) ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ, m < 3 → ∀ xi : ℝ,
        ‖iteratedDeriv m
          (FourierTransform.fourier (fun x : ℝ ↦ (psi x : ℂ))) xi‖ ≤

theorem aux_leftBumpOneShort_lintegral_energy_eq_prism_of_setIntegral

    (F : Fin (d + 1) → SchwartzMap (RealVector (d + 1)) ℝ)
    (E : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hKint : ∀ z : RealVector 1 × ℝ,
      Kint z = ∫ t : ℝ in Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2, K t z)
    (hInt : Integrable (fun q : ℝ ×
      ((RealVector 1 × RealVector 1) × RealVector (d + 1)) =>
      K q.1 (q.2.1.2 - q.2.1.1, coordinateSum q.2.1.1 + coordinateSum q.2.2) *
        ∏ h : Fin 1 → Fin 2, ∏ i : Fin (d + 1),
          F (prismIndex (n := d + 1) (k := 1) (by omega) (by omega) i)
            (prismPoint (n := d + 1) (k := 1) (by omega) (by omega) q.2.1 q.2.2 h i))
      ((volume.restrict (Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2)).prod volume))
    (hPint : Integrable (fun t : ℝ =>
      prismBrascampLiebForm (d + 1) 1 (by omega) (by omega) (K t)
        (fun i x => F i x)) (volume.restrict (Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2)))
    (hPnonneg : ∀ᵐ t : ℝ ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2)),
      0 ≤ prismBrascampLiebForm (d + 1) 1 (by omega) (by omega) (K t)
        (fun i x => F i x))
    (hE : ∀ᵐ t : ℝ ∂(volume.restrict (Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2)),
      E t = ENNReal.ofReal
        (prismBrascampLiebForm (d + 1) 1 (by omega) (by omega) (K t)
          (fun i x => F i x))) :
    ∫⁻ t in Set.Icc (1 : ℝ) 2, E t =
      ENNReal.ofReal
        (prismBrascampLiebForm (d + 1) 1 (by omega) (by omega) Kint
          (fun i x => F i x))

statement:
theorem aux_mainTwisted_jumpNorm_add_le {n J : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)

name: Auto.aux_mainTwisted_jump_norm_add_le
statement:
theorem aux_mainTwisted_jump_norm_add_le {n J : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (f : Fin n → SchwartzMap (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℝ)
    (t : aux_scaleChain J) (j : Fin J) (u v : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hu : MemLp u 2 volume) (hv : MemLp v 2 volume) :
    eLpNorm
      (fun x ↦ twistedAverageAtScale (t.1 j.succ) (u + v) (fun i y ↦ f i y) x -
        twistedAverageAtScale (t.1 j.castSucc) (u + v) (fun i y ↦ f i y) x)
      2 volume ≤
      eLpNorm
        (fun x ↦ twistedAverageAtScale (t.1 j.succ) u (fun i y ↦ f i y) x -
          twistedAverageAtScale (t.1 j.castSucc) u (fun i y ↦ f i y) x)
        2 volume +
      eLpNorm
        (fun x ↦ twistedAverageAtScale (t.1 j.succ) v (fun i y ↦ f i y) x -
          twistedAverageAtScale (t.1 j.castSucc) v (fun i y ↦ f i y) x)
        2 volume

name: Auto.aux_mainTwisted_jump_norm_le_tsum
statement:
theorem aux_mainTwisted_jump_norm_le_tsum {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)

    (phi : ℝ → ℝ) (phiJ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hphi : MemLp phi 2 volume) (hphiJ : ∀ q, MemLp (phiJ q) 2 volume)
    (hconv : Tendsto (fun N ↦ eLpNorm
      (phi - ∑ q ∈ Finset.range N, phiJ q) 2 volume) atTop (nhds 0))
    {s r : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hr : 0 < r) :
    eLpNorm
      (fun x ↦ twistedAverageAtScale s phi (fun i y ↦ f i y) x -
        twistedAverageAtScale r phi (fun i y ↦ f i y) x)
      2 volume ≤
      ∑' q, eLpNorm
        (fun x ↦ twistedAverageAtScale s (phiJ q) (fun i y ↦ f i y) x -
          twistedAverageAtScale r (phiJ q) (fun i y ↦ f i y) x)
        2 volume

          aux_mainTwisted_low_jumpNorm t f.1 (windowBasedBumpFunctions.phiZero b 0) j +
          ∑' q : ℕ,

name: Auto.aux_mainTwisted_pointwise_smoothing_bound
statement:
theorem aux_mainTwisted_pointwise_smoothing_bound {n J : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (b : windowBasedBumpFunctions)
    (f : Fin n → SchwartzMap (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℝ)
    (t : aux_scaleChain J) (j : Fin J)
    (hI : MemLp (aux_indicator (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) 2 volume)
    (hphi0 : MemLp (fun x ↦ b.phi0 x) 2 volume)
    (hzero : ∀ k : ℤ, MemLp (windowBasedBumpFunctions.phiZero b k) 2 volume)
    (hone : ∀ k : ℤ, MemLp (windowBasedBumpFunctions.phiOne b k) 2 volume)
    (htwo : ∀ k : ℤ, MemLp (windowBasedBumpFunctions.phiTwo b k) 2 volume) :
    aux_mainTwisted_jumpNorm f t j (aux_indicator (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) ≤
      aux_mainTwisted_jumpNorm f t j (fun x ↦ b.phi0 x) +
        (aux_mainTwisted_jumpNorm f t j (windowBasedBumpFunctions.phiZero b (-2)) +
          (aux_mainTwisted_jumpNorm f t j (windowBasedBumpFunctions.phiZero b (-1)) +
            aux_mainTwisted_jumpNorm f t j (windowBasedBumpFunctions.phiZero b 0)) +
          ∑' q : ℕ, aux_mainTwisted_jumpNorm f t j
            (windowBasedBumpFunctions.phiZero b ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) +
        ∑' q : ℕ, aux_mainTwisted_jumpNorm f t j
          (windowBasedBumpFunctions.phiOne b (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) +
        ∑' q : ℕ, aux_mainTwisted_jumpNorm f t j
          (windowBasedBumpFunctions.phiTwo b (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)))

statement:
theorem aux_mainTwisted_terminal_aggregation {n J : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (b : windowBasedBumpFunctions)
    (f : Fin n → SchwartzMap (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℝ)
    (t : aux_scaleChain J) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hI : MemLp (aux_indicator (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) 2 volume)
    (hphi0 : MemLp (fun x ↦ b.phi0 x) 2 volume)
    (hzero : ∀ k : ℤ, MemLp (windowBasedBumpFunctions.phiZero b k) 2 volume)
    (hone : ∀ k : ℤ, MemLp (windowBasedBumpFunctions.phiOne b k) 2 volume)
    (htwo : ∀ k : ℤ, MemLp (windowBasedBumpFunctions.phiTwo b k) 2 volume)
    (hC0 : 0 ≤ C_mainBumpOne n) (hC1 : 0 ≤ C_mainBumpTwo n)
    (hC2 : 0 ≤ C_leftBump n) (hC3 : 0 ≤ C_leftBumpOne n)
    (h0 : ∑ j : Fin J, (aux_mainTwisted_jumpNorm f t j (fun x ↦ b.phi0 x)) ^ 2 ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (C_mainBumpOne n) * R)
    (h1 : ∑ j : Fin J,
        (aux_mainTwisted_jumpNorm f t j (windowBasedBumpFunctions.phiZero b (-2)) +
          (aux_mainTwisted_jumpNorm f t j (windowBasedBumpFunctions.phiZero b (-1)) +
            aux_mainTwisted_jumpNorm f t j (windowBasedBumpFunctions.phiZero b 0)) +
          ∑' q : ℕ, aux_mainTwisted_jumpNorm f t j
            (windowBasedBumpFunctions.phiZero b ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ))) ^ 2 ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (64 * C_mainBumpTwo n) * R)
    (h2 : ∑ j : Fin J,
        (∑' q : ℕ, aux_mainTwisted_jumpNorm f t j
          (windowBasedBumpFunctions.phiOne b (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)))) ^ 2 ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (C_leftBump n) * R)
    (h3 : ∑ j : Fin J,
        (∑' q : ℕ, aux_mainTwisted_jumpNorm f t j
          (windowBasedBumpFunctions.phiTwo b (-((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ)))) ^ 2 ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (64 * C_leftBumpOne n) * R) :
    ∑ j : Fin J,
      (aux_mainTwisted_jumpNorm f t j (aux_indicator (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1))) ^ 2 ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (C_mainTwistedTheorem n) * R

    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (J : ℕ), 0 < J → ∀ (t : Fin (J + 1) → ℝ),
      StrictMono t → (∀ j, 0 < t j) →
      ∀ f : Fin n → SchwartzMap (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℝ,
        (∀ i, eLpNorm (f i) ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (i.val + min (n - i.val) 2)) volume = 1) →
        ∑ j : Fin J, eLpNorm
            (fun x ↦ twistedAverageAtScale (t j.succ) unitIntervalIndicator
                (fun i y ↦ f i y) x -
              twistedAverageAtScale (t j.castSucc) unitIntervalIndicator
                (fun i y ↦ f i y) x)
            2 volume ^ 2 ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal C * ENNReal.ofReal
            ((J : ℝ) ^ (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℝ) + 2)))

        ∑ j : Fin J, eLpNorm

                (fun i y ↦ f i y) x -
              twistedAverageAtScale (t j.castSucc) unitIntervalIndicator
                (fun i y ↦ f i y) x)
            2 volume ^ 2 ≤

name: Auto.aux_endpoint_core_bound_from_schwartz
statement:
theorem aux_endpoint_core_bound_from_schwartz
    {n J : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hJ : 0 < J)
    (p : Fin n → ENNReal) [∀ i, Fact (1 ≤ p i)]
    (hp_top : ∀ i, p i ≠ ∞)
    (hpsum : ∑ i, (p i)⁻¹ = (2 : ENNReal)⁻¹)
    (t : Fin (J + 1) → ℝ) (htpos : ∀ k, 0 < t k)
    (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (hqsum : ∑ i, (mainEndpointExponent n (π i))⁻¹ = (2 : ENNReal)⁻¹)
    (hreal : ∀ f : Fin n → SchwartzMap (rteRealVector n) ℝ,
      endpointEnergy J t unitIntervalKernel (fun i x ↦ f i x) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal ((2 : ℝ) ^ 666) * ENNReal.ofReal (jumpGrowth n J) *
          ∏ i, eLpNorm (f i) (mainEndpointExponent n (π i)) volume ^ 2)
    (g : Fin n → SimpleFunc (rteRealVector n) ℂ)
    (hg : ∀ i, Integrable (g i : rteRealVector n → ℂ) volume) :
    ‖RawStability.aux_endpointLpCMLM p hp_top hpsum t htpos
        (fun i ↦ ((SimpleFunc.memLp_iff_integrable
          (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (Fact.out : 1 ≤ p i))) (hp_top i)).mpr
            (hg i)).toLp (g i))‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (C_interpolated_real_variable_estimate n * jumpGrowth n J) *
        ∏ i, eLpNorm (g i : rteRealVector n → ℂ)
          (mainEndpointExponent n (π i)) volume ^ 2

name: Auto.aux_generic_core_endpoint_bound

theorem aux_generic_core_endpoint_bound
    {n J : ℕ} (p q : Fin n → ENNReal) [∀ i, Fact (1 ≤ p i)] [∀ i, Fact (1 ≤ q i)]

theorem aux_main_twisted_theorem {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∀ (J : ℕ), 0 < J → ∀ (t : Fin (J + 1) → ℝ),
      StrictMono t → (∀ j, 0 < t j) →
      ∀ f : Fin n → SchwartzMap (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℝ,
        (∀ i, eLpNorm (f i) ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (i.val + min (n - i.val) 2)) volume = 1) →
        ∑ j : Fin J, eLpNorm
            (fun x ↦ aux_rte_twistedAverageAtScale (t j.succ)
                ((Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).indicator fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ))

              aux_rte_twistedAverageAtScale (t j.castSucc)
                ((Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).indicator fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ))
                (fun i x ↦ f i x) x)
            2 volume ^ 2 ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal ((2 : ℝ) ^ 666) * ENNReal.ofReal

name: Auto.aux_multilinear_interpolation_endpointPolytope_sq_of_packed

    {m : ℕ} {X Y : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y]
    {μ : Measure X} {ν : Measure Y} [SigmaFinite ν]
    (p : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ≥0∞) (hp : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p i)
    (hptop : ∀ i, p i ≠ ∞)
    (hpoly : (fun i ↦ ((p i)⁻¹).toReal) ∈ endpointPolytope (m + 1))
    (B : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ SimpleFunc X ℂ) (Lp ℂ 2 ν))
    (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hendpointBox : ∀ i : Fin (m + 1),
      0 < endpointReciprocalVector (m + 1) i ∧
        endpointReciprocalVector (m + 1) i ≤ 1)
    (hendpointExponent : ∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (m + 1))) (i : Fin (m + 1)),
      Auto.multilinearExponentOfReciprocal
          (fun j ↦ endpointReciprocalVector (m + 1) (π j)) i =
        mainEndpointExponent (m + 1) (π i))
    (hendpoint : ∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (m + 1)))
        (g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      (∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ) →
        ‖B g‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal D * ∏ i,
          eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (mainEndpointExponent (m + 1) (π i)) μ ^ 2)
    (hzero : ∀ (u : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 < u i ∧ u i ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ) (i : Fin (m + 1)),
        eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (Auto.multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i) μ = 0 →
          ‖B g‖ₑ = 0)
    (g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
    (hg : ∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ) :
    ‖B g‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal D * ∏ i,
      eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (p i) μ ^ 2

statement:

    (B : MultilinearMap ℂ (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) ↦ SimpleFunc X ℂ) (Lp ℂ 2 ν))
    (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 < D)
    (hreciprocal : ∀ i : Fin (m + 1),

    (hendpoint : ∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin (m + 1)))
        (g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ),
      (∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ) →
        ‖B g‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal D * ∏ i,
          eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (mainEndpointExponent (m + 1) (π i)) μ ^ 2)
    (hzero : ∀ (u : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 < u i ∧ u i ≤ 1) →
      ∀ (g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ) (i : Fin (m + 1)),
        eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (Auto.multilinearExponentOfReciprocal u i) μ = 0 →
          ‖B g‖ₑ = 0)
    (g : Fin (m + 1) → SimpleFunc X ℂ)
    (hg : ∀ i, Integrable (g i : X → ℂ) μ) :
    ‖B g‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal D * ∏ i,
      eLpNorm (g i : X → ℂ) (p i) μ ^ 2

name: Auto.aux_nCT_main_ergodic_theorem
statement:
theorem aux_nCT_main_ergodic_theorem {X : Type u} [MeasurableSpace X]
    {μ : Measure X} {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) {r : ℝ}
    (hr : 2 ^ (n - 1) < r ∨ (n = 2 ∧ 2 ≤ r)) [SigmaFinite μ]
    {T : Fin n → X → X} (hT : ∀ i, MeasurePreserving (T i) μ μ)
    (hT' : ∀ i j x, (T i) (T j x) = (T j) (T i x)) {f : Fin n → X → ℂ}
    (hf : ∀ i, MemLp (f i) (2 * n) μ) :
    ∀ N, MemLp (nCT.multipleErgodicAverage f T N) 2 μ ∧
    nCT.variationSeminorm (eLpNorm · 2 μ) r (nCT.multipleErgodicAverage f T)
      ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C_main_ergodic_theorem n r) * ∏ i, eLpNorm (f i) (2 * n) μ

    (hf : ∀ i, eLpNorm (f i) ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ min n (i.val + 2)) volume = 1) :
    ∑ j : Fin J, eLpNorm
        (fun x ↦ nCT.rescaledTwistedAverage (t j.succ)
            ((Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).indicator fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ))
            (fun i x ↦ f i x) x -
          nCT.rescaledTwistedAverage (t j.castSucc)
            ((Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).indicator fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ))
            (fun i x ↦ f i x) x)
        2 volume ^ 2 ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ 666 * (J : ℝ≥0∞) ^
        (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℝ) + 2))

    (hjump : ∀ (L : ℕ), 1 ≤ L → ∀ (M : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ),
      StrictMono M → (∀ q, 0 < M q) →
      (∑ q : Fin L, ‖a (M q.succ) - a (M q.castSucc)‖ ^ (2 : ℕ)) ≤

statement:
theorem chain_variation_rpow_bound {B : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup B]
    {J : ℕ} (a : ℕ → B) (N : Fin (J + 1) → ℕ)
    (hN : StrictMono N) (hNpos : ∀ j, 0 < N j)
    {r0 D r : ℝ} (hr0 : 2 ≤ r0) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hr : r0 < r)
    (hjump : ∀ (L : ℕ), 1 ≤ L → ∀ (M : Fin (L + 1) → ℕ),
      StrictMono M → (∀ q, 0 < M q) →
      (∑ q : Fin L, ‖a (M q.succ) - a (M q.castSucc)‖ ^ (2 : ℕ)) ≤

    (∑ j : Fin J, ‖a (N j.succ) - a (N j.castSucc)‖ ^ r) ≤

name: Auto.eLpNorm_ergodicAverage_sub_complex_le_sum
statement:

    (N M : ℕ) (f : Fin n → X → ℂ)
    (hmem : ∀ ε : Fin n → Fin 2,
      MemLp (fun x ↦ aux_realErgodicAverage S N (complexComponent ε f) x -

name: Auto.endpointEnergy_homogeneous
statement:

    (B : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hendpoint : ∀ g : Fin n → SchwartzMap (rteRealVector n) ℝ,

name: Auto.lower_endpointWeight
statement:
theorem lower_endpointWeight : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m →
    ∀ I : Finset (Fin m), I.Nonempty →
      2 ^ I.card ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, endpointWeight m i
  | 0, hm => by omega
  | 1, _ => by
    intro I hI
    have hIeq : I = Finset.univ := by
      apply Finset.eq_univ_of_card I
      apply Nat.le_antisymm (Finset.card_le_univ I)
      change 1 ≤ I.card
      have hpos := Finset.card_pos.mpr hI
      omega
    subst I
    norm_num [endpointWeight]
  | m + 2, _ => by
    intro I hI
    by_cases h0 : 0 ∈ I
    · let J : Finset (Fin (m + 1)) := tailOf (m + 1) I
      have hsumI :
          ∑ i ∈ I, endpointWeight (m + 2) i =
            2 ^ (m + 1) + ∑ i ∈ J, endpointWeight (m + 1) i := by
        exact sum_endpointWeight_of_zero_mem m I h0
      have hcardI : I.card = J.card + 1 := by
        exact card_tailOf_of_zero_mem m I h0
      by_cases hJ : J.Nonempty
      · have htail := lower_endpointWeight (m + 1) (by omega) J hJ
        have hJcard : J.card ≤ m + 1 := by
          simpa only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using Finset.card_le_univ J
        have hpow : 2 ^ J.card ≤ 2 ^ (m + 1) :=
          Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hJcard
        rw [hsumI, hcardI, pow_succ]
        calc
          2 ^ J.card * 2 = 2 ^ J.card + 2 ^ J.card

      (∑ i, b (σ i)) = S ∧ ∀ I : Finset (Fin n), I.Nonempty →

name: Auto.multilinear_interpolation_external
statement:
theorem multilinear_interpolation_external {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (p : Fin n → ℝ≥0∞) (hp : ∀ i, 1 ≤ p i)
    (hpoly : (fun i ↦ ((p i)⁻¹).toReal) ∈ endpointPolytope n)
    (J : ℕ) (hJ : 0 < J) (t : Fin (J + 1) → ℝ)
    (_ht : StrictMono t) (htpos : ∀ j, 0 < t j)
    (hendpoint : ∀ (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
        (g : Fin n → SchwartzMap (rteRealVector n) ℝ),
      endpointEnergy J t unitIntervalKernel (fun i x ↦ g i x) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal ((2 : ℝ) ^ 666) * ENNReal.ofReal (jumpGrowth n J) *
          ∏ i, eLpNorm (g i) (mainEndpointExponent n (π i)) volume ^ 2) :
    (∀ f : Fin n → rteRealVector n → ℂ, (∀ i, MemLp (f i) (p i) volume) →
      complexEndpointEnergy J t unitIntervalKernel f ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (C_interpolated_real_variable_estimate n) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (jumpGrowth n J) *
            ∏ i, eLpNorm (f i) (p i) volume ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ f : Fin n → rteRealVector n → ℝ, (∀ i, MemLp (f i) (p i) volume) →
      endpointEnergy J t unitIntervalKernel f ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (C_interpolated_real_variable_estimate n) *
          ENNReal.ofReal (jumpGrowth n J) *
            ∏ i, eLpNorm (f i) (p i) volume ^ 2)

      (∑ q : Fin L, ‖a (M q.succ) - a (M q.castSucc)‖ ^ (2 : ℕ)) ≤
        D * (L : ℝ) ^ (1 - 2 / r0))

name: Auto.sum_endpointWeight
statement:
theorem sum_endpointWeight : ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m →
    (∑ i, endpointWeight m i) = 2 ^ m
  | 0, hm => by omega
  | 1, _ => by norm_num [endpointWeight]
  | m + 2, _ => by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    rw [endpointWeight_zero]
    simp_rw [endpointWeight_succ]
    rw [sum_endpointWeight (m + 1) (by omega), pow_succ]

      2 ^ m * 2 + 2 ^ m * 2 = 2 ^ m * (2 * 2)

theorem main_ergodic_theorem (hn : 2 ≤ n) {r : ℝ} (hr : 2 ^ (n - 1) < r ∨ (n = 2 ∧ 2 ≤ r))
    [SigmaFinite μ] {T : Fin n → X → X} (hT : ∀ i, MeasurePreserving (T i) μ μ)
    (hT' : ∀ i j x, (T i) (T j x) = (T j) (T i x)) {f : Fin n → X → ℂ}
    (hf : ∀ i, MemLp (f i) (2 * n) μ) :
    ∀ N, MemLp (multipleErgodicAverage f T N) 2 μ ∧
    variationSeminorm (eLpNorm · 2 μ) r (multipleErgodicAverage f T)
      ≤ C_main_ergodic_theorem n r * ∏ i, eLpNorm (f i) (2 * n) μ

name: nCT.main_twisted_theorem
statement:
theorem main_twisted_theorem (hn : 2 ≤ n) {J : ℕ}
    {t : Fin (J + 1) → ℝ} (ht : ∀ i, 0 < t i) (ht' : StrictMono t)
    {f : Fin n → 𝓢(ℝ^n, ℝ)} (hf : ∀ i, eLpNorm (f i) (2 ^ min n (i + 2)) volume = 1) :
    ∑ j : Fin J, eLpNorm (𝐀 (t (j.succ))  (𝟙 (Icc 0 1)) (f ·)
      - 𝐀 (t j.castSucc) (𝟙 (Icc 0 1)) (f ·)) 2 volume ^ 2
        ≤ 2 ^ 666 * J ^ (1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℝ) + 2))

name: nCT.tao_norm_convergence
statement:
theorem tao_norm_convergence
    {n : ℕ} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {T : Fin n → X → X} (hT : ∀ i, MeasurePreserving (T i) μ μ)
    (hT' : ∀ i j x, T i (T j x) = T j (T i x))
    (hT'' : ∀ i, Function.Bijective (T i))
    {f : Fin n → X → ℂ} (hf : ∀ i, MemLp (f i) ∞ μ) :
    ∃ g : X → ℂ, MemLp g 2 μ ∧
      Tendsto (fun N ↦ eLpNorm (nCT.multipleErgodicAverage f T N - g) 2 μ) atTop (𝓝 0)
